Marta (Growth): Quick thread for tomorrow's mini-webinar prep. Goal: lock topic, finalize two abstracts, and confirm who triages inbound leads during Q&A. Short answers please.

Ike (Producer): Green room 17:30 PT. Live run 17:45. Mic checks at 17:35. Can we keep total runtime to 35m (5m intro, 20m demo+cases, 10m Q&A)?

Lina (Content): Topic pick leaning towards "Cost-first inference patterns" vs "Edge-friendly quantization stories". I have two abstracts: A) Practical cost wins we measure (benchmarks + before/after) B) How teams ship smaller model variants without quality loss (strategies + evals). Thoughts?

Noah (Speaker): I prefer A for marketing resonance. Benchmarks give tangible CTAs. Happy to compress to 15m demo + 5m case study.

Pri (Host): Agree A. For abstracts: can we make the hook data-first? e.g., "Cut token cost by 40% while maintaining latency and quality". That hooks PMs and infra folks.

Marta (Growth): Strong. Audience routing: Noah will handle product/strategy; I'll triage growth/lead ops; Lina to capture follow-up content. Set private slack channel for lead flags -> #webinar-287-leads?

Ike (Producer): Created private channel and invited Marta + Noah + OpsBot. On-call infra: pinging @eng-runtime to confirm a standby.

OpsBot: Reminder scheduled: "Mic-checks in 15m" -> 2861234670.

Lina (Content): Draft abstract v1 posted: "Learn how teams reduced per-inference token cost by 30-50% via batching, KV caching, and selective quantization. We show benchmarks and the exact config changes used." Feedback: tighten the CTA and add a single-line promised takeaway.

Noah (Speaker): Edits: add "includes config snippets and rollout checklist". I'll upload slides by EOD.

Pri (Host): Q&A routing: I'll read audience Qs aloud, Noah to answer technical ones, Marta to capture potential MQLs and drop to #webinar-287-leads. If demo error, switch to pre-recorded clip at assets/fallbacks/demo_short.mp4 and call the fallback line: "See the lightweight guide in docs if you experience latency."

Marta (Growth): All good. Last ask: enable captions and recording. Lina, please pin the final abstract in the channel when done.

Ike (Producer): Done: captions on, recording enabled. See you all in green room.

Noah (Speaker): :thumbsup: uploading slides now.
